cands.name: Mike Friend
cands.bio: Democratic nominee for open HD 102; dentist and self-described Blue Dog Democrat, 50. First-time candidate; previously lobbied in Tallahassee through the Florida Dental Association.

record.text: Has not held elected office. Won the Democratic primary with 52% over Jayden D'Onofrio. Priorities: lower household costs, property insurance, public schools, abortion access, public safety.

money_notes.text: Raised $109,000 plus $50,000 in loans through July 31. Endorsed by industry groups including the Florida Dental Association, Florida Bankers Association, Florida Realtors PAC, Florida Home Builders Association and Florida Justice Reform Institute.

endorsements.text: South Florida Sun-Sentinel; Florida Chamber of Commerce; Broward Teachers Union; AFL-CIO; Reps. Gottlieb, Bartleman, Daley, Rosenwald, Tant, Woodson; and Republican Cooper City Commissioner Jason Smith, who lost the GOP primary.

cands.name: Mery Lopez-Palma
cands.bio: Republican nominee for HD 102; lawyer and entrepreneur, 56. Born in Cuba and brought to Florida as a child. Lost the 2024 HD 102 race to Michael Gottlieb, who won with 53.6%.
cands.local_ties: Friend's campaign says she lives outside HD 102 (Florida Politics); her own residence statement not found.

record.text: Has not held elected office. Won the GOP primary with 58.1% over Cooper City Commissioner Jason Smith; cites building a law firm and other businesses.

money_notes.text: Through July: $48,700 in contributions and $59,000 in loans; spent $95,000, more than twice her primary opponent.

endorsements.text: Several local mayors endorsed her in the primary.
